reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Ben Thompson, the founder and author of Stratechery.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Ben Thompson, the founder and author of Stratechery. Ben is one of my favorite business thinkers and I love talking to him about everything happening in markets and technology. We go through every important company, including OpenAI, Nvidia, Intel, Apple, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon.

key_points.text: We also discuss why he thinks it would be dangerous for the United States to win the AI race outright.
Please enjoy my conversation with Ben Thompson.
